question: What event at the time of bodily death is marked as decisive?
premises: The verse specifies the moment of body-fall
The piercing of the skull is named as occurring then
inference: At the fall of the body, the skull is pierced at that moment
uncertainties: Whether kapālambhidyate implies yogic exit or another event is unclear from this verse alone
plain_english: O Goddess, when the body falls, then the skull is pierced.
